$Comment: Ice King's flying template (2026-10-22): a copy of vanilla Template_Flying_Aggressive (Assets.zip 0.7.3) with ONE change. In .Chase, when the target is out of line of sight, the vanilla template overrides his altitude to [0, 2] ('try chasing the target to its altitude range'). Under trees, or when Mob Battle's wand sets him to chase, that brought him down next to the player or the dummy and kept him there, and the flips between combat and chase also re-armed the 'Once' rules (looping voices, fixed with flags). Here that override uses MotionDesiredAltitudeCombat, so he keeps his combat height while he looks for the target. Used by AT_Ice_King_Air and AT_Ice_King_Air_Enraged (Reference). Everything else is vanilla; re-copy and re-apply this one change after a game update that changes the original. Second change (2026-10-22: he ended up circling right over the target, 90 degrees up): MinAirSpeed 0 (vanilla 3). While he casts, nothing moves him (the orbit waits, MatchLook only turns him to face the target), and with a minimum air speed he kept flying forward, toward the target, until he was overhead; now he hovers where he is on the ring during a cast. 2026-10-22: first instruction runs the encounter's falling attacks when it sends their beacons (the king owns the damage). 2026-10-22: watchdog rules at the top (15 s of continuous interaction -> Root_AT_Ice_King_Unstick cancels his chains, '[IceKing] watchdog' in the log).

DisableDamageGroups.Description: Groups whose damage this NPC ignores.

MotionDesiredAltitudeCombat.Description: The altitude range the NPC prefers attacking from

MotionDesiredAltitudeSearch.Description: The altitude range the NPC prefers searching in

AbsoluteDetectionRange.Description: The range at which the NPC will always detect players and NPCs

IdleWanderTime.Description: How long the NPC will wander for

IdleWanderInCircleTime.Description: How long the NPC will wander in circle for

IdleWanderInCircleRadius.Description: The radius of the WanderInCircle motion

IdleNothingTime.Description: How long the NPC will stand still for while wandering

IdleFollowPath.Description: Whether the NPC will follow a path while idling

IdleFollowPathRange.Description: The maximum distance within which the NPC will look for a path

IdleFollowPathShape.Description: The shape of the followed path

AlertedRange.Description: A range within which the player can be seen/sensed when the NPC is alerted to their presence

AlertedTime.Description: How long the NPC will stay in the alerted state before engaging the target

AlertedAdditionalBehaviorComponent.Description: The component defining additional alerted behavior

CombatBehaviorDistance.Description: The distance at which the NPC will use combat movement

CombatRelativeSpeedFlyMotion.Description: The relative speed at which the NPC will move when within attack range and while flying

CombatRelativeSpeedChase.Description: The relative speed at which the NPC will move when chasing

RangedAttack.Description: The ranged attack to use in combat

RangedAttackDistance.Description: The distance at which an NPC will execute ranged attacks

RangedAttackAimingRange.Description: How long the NPC will take to aim at the target

RangedAttackPauseRange.Description: How often the NPC will attack the target

TargetSwitchTimer.Description: Minimum time the NPC will be locked onto a single target before switching

CombatSeekSlowdownDistance.Description: The target distance at which a chasing NPC will slow down

CombatSeekStopDistance.Description: The target distance at which a chasing NPC will stop

TargetRange.Description: The distance the target needs to be within to maintain priority over other targets while in combat

CombatAdditionalBehaviorComponent.Description: The component defining additional combat behavior

ConfusedTimeRange.Description: The range during which the NPC will be confused after losing a target

SearchTimeRange.Description: The time range during which the NPC will search for a lost target

SearchRadius.Description: The radius within which the NPC will search for a lost target

SearchRelativeSpeed.Description: The relative speed of the chase motion

IsMemory.Description: Defines if the NPC is a memory

MemoriesCategory.Description: Defines the category of the memory

MemoriesNameOverride.Description: Overrides the memory name if set

MemoriesUnlockedBy.Description: How the player records the memory, either Proximity or Kill.

MemoriesKillRange.Description: Radius in blocks in which the memory is recorded when the NPC dies. 0 uses the server default.

NameTranslationKey.Description: Translation key for NPC name display

DeathParticles.Description: The particle system that spawns when the NPC's corpse disappears.

DropDeathItemsInstantly.Description: Whether the NPC's drop list should be executed when the NPC dies. If set to false, items drop when the corpse disappears.

DeathAnimationTime.Description: The time it takes for this NPC's corpse to disappear.

HitInterruptEnabled.Description: Whether hits can interrupt this NPC.

FlinchAnimation.Description: The flinch animation from this NPC's model.

Ice King (2026-10-22, harness test: the air king healed from 2088 to 3000 while nobody could hit him): disable health regen on entry, as Template_AT_Ice_King and the vanilla boss templates do. Without it the Health stat regenerates 5% every 0.5 s after 15 s without damage (Entity/Stats/Health.json). The air components also turned it off, but only inside their once-per-role combat rule, so a king that had not reached combat yet, or lost his target, kept regenerating.
Detect hostile targets
If configured to do so, follow a path
Else, do a general wander motion sequence
Play an alerted animation
Watch the target
If damage is taken, enter combat immediately
If the target starts moving away, enter combat
After a time out, enter combat
If target is lost, wait the time out and go to Idle instead
Try switching targets once in a while
Basic combat behaviour
Set the desired combat altitude range

Attack the target when within ranged attack distance Ice King (2026-10-22: far away the phase 4 ultimate came, close up only 'basic attacks'): OFF. This vanilla rule fired the RangedAttack (Root_AT_Ice_King_Ice_Ray) whenever the target was within RangedAttackDistance (30), with no busy check, and stepped on the component's attacks: the ultimate's Attack logged as cast every 29-30 s but its chain never started (no warning effect) while the player was within 30 blocks; with the player farther it always ran. The air components (Component_AT_Ice_King_Air_Combat / _Air_Enraged_Combat) hold all the attacks. RangedAttackDistance is still used by the state changes below, so it stays.
Flying: execute combat-oriented movement when the target spots the NPC
Fallback: go to .Chase (target loss is handled there)
Chase the target
Try chasing the target to its altitude range when LoS is broken
If stuck, climb to try unstucking (?!) itself
When the target is back into attack distance, go to .Default
